tasks.title: Apply Neem Oil Solution
tasks.details: Mix neem oil with water (2 tablespoons per liter). Add a few drops of liquid soap as emulsifier. Spray on affected areas.

tasks.title: Turmeric Paste Application
tasks.details: Prepare paste with turmeric powder and water. Apply on visible spots. Turmeric has natural antibacterial properties.

tasks.title: Garlic Water Spray
tasks.details: Crush 5-6 garlic cloves in 1 liter water. Let sit overnight, strain, and spray on plants.

tasks.title: Second Neem Application
tasks.details: Repeat neem oil treatment. Ensure good coverage of all plant parts.

tasks.title: Assess Plant Health
tasks.details: Check for improvement in symptoms. Look for reduction in spot size and number.

tasks.title: Preventive Neem Treatment
tasks.details: Apply neem oil as preventive measure. Continue weekly applications for one month.
